blockedReasons.summary: No reviewed clipboard API permission, read, write, or paste boundary exists.
No prompt, response, transcript, or message body content is present.
Transcript export needs explicit storage, retention, and redaction boundaries.
Clipboard-backed attachments require a reviewed attachment payload boundary.
Clipboard import and export need explicit redaction and persistence review.

clipboardControls.contentPolicy: no message body, selection text, response text, or prompt text
clipboardControls.label: copy message
clipboardControls.launcherAction: Keep copy disabled and do not request clipboard write permission.
clipboardControls.userAction: Copy only after message content, selection, redaction, and clipboard write boundaries are reviewed.

clipboardControls.contentPolicy: no transcript, prompt, response, session title, or summary content
clipboardControls.label: copy transcript
clipboardControls.launcherAction: Keep transcript copy disabled and do not read transcript data.
clipboardControls.userAction: Copy transcripts only after storage, retention, and redaction policy exists.

clipboardControls.contentPolicy: no clipboard text or prompt text
clipboardControls.label: paste prompt
clipboardControls.launcherAction: Keep paste disabled and do not inspect clipboard contents.
clipboardControls.userAction: Paste only after an explicit local clipboard read and prompt redaction boundary exists.

clipboardControls.contentPolicy: no clipboard payload, file name, path, metadata, preview, or bytes
clipboardControls.label: paste attachment
clipboardControls.launcherAction: Keep clipboard attachments disabled and do not read clipboard payloads.
clipboardControls.userAction: Paste attachments only after local attachment and clipboard payload policies are reviewed.

clipboardControls.contentPolicy: no clipboard text, image, file, path, metadata, preview, or bytes
clipboardControls.label: import clipboard payload
clipboardControls.launcherAction: Do not import, parse, index, or persist clipboard data.
clipboardControls.userAction: Import clipboard data only after type limits, redaction, and persistence review.

clipboardControls.contentPolicy: no transcript, message, error detail, file, path, model, runtime, or artifact content
clipboardControls.label: export to clipboard
clipboardControls.launcherAction: Do not write transcript, message, error, file, or artifact data to the clipboard.
clipboardControls.userAction: Export to clipboard only after explicit user action and redaction policy exists.

clipboardPolicy.contentPolicy: clipboard policy metadata only; no clipboard text, prompt text, response text, transcript text, selection text, file names, paths, bytes, or artifacts are included
clipboardPolicy.persistencePolicy: no clipboard read, write, paste, copy, import, export, attachment, transcript, session, or artifact persistence
clipboardPolicy.sourcePolicy: checked fixture only; no clipboard API, selection, message, transcript, prompt, attachment, file, artifact, session store, model path, or runtime log is read

clipboardSurfaces.label: message actions
clipboardSurfaces.summary: Copy message controls remain disabled because no message content is captured.

clipboardSurfaces.label: composer input
clipboardSurfaces.summary: Paste into the composer remains disabled until an explicit clipboard read boundary exists.

clipboardSurfaces.label: attachment input
clipboardSurfaces.summary: Clipboard-backed attachments remain disabled until attachment ingestion and redaction rules exist.

clipboardSurfaces.label: transcript export
clipboardSurfaces.summary: Transcript copy/export remains disabled until retention and redaction boundaries are reviewed.

handoffRefs.summary: Composer data keeps paste controls disabled.
Action bar data keeps copy/export controls disabled.
Empty message-list data prevents message copy actions.
Attachment policy data keeps clipboard-backed attachment reads disabled.
Transcript persistence and export remain unavailable.
Local-only policy keeps provider, cloud, network, and upload paths unavailable.

limitations: Data-only chat clipboard-policy fixture; no clipboard content, selection, prompt, response, transcript, message body, file, artifact, model path, runtime log, or private path is read or written.
Clipboard read, write, paste, copy, import, export, transcript-copy, message-copy, and clipboard-backed attachment controls remain disabled or blocked.
No session store, transcript, message body, attachment, artifact, private path, secret, token, log, or hardware dump is read or written.
No clipboard API request, prompt capture, transcript export, upload, import, model load, runtime execution, provider call, network call, or KV260 hardware access is performed.
This is not a release, tag, compatibility commitment, MCP, LSP, IDE, marketplace, telemetry, or runtime implementation.
